description: ⭐ THE COMMONS WITH COINS, THE WILD PAIR OFF (Dean, 10/09/2026). READ: the bonus rate on the turn measure by seat count, the PLAY / COIN TAKE / SLOT UNSPENT split (a gate this hard should push traffic off the play and onto the free coin take, which is the solitaire law watching a free option in the slot), the door mix, and branching, which should FALL here because the pair is what adds C(h,2) fee options per board. ⛔ NOTHING ELSE MOVES: same mint, same two sinks, same price of 3, same bonus timing, same currency.
